messages:
Noah Reed: Quick brief: one-pager + mini landing block for enterprise buyers focused on Security, SLA guarantees, and Deployment modes (Hosted/Dedicated/Private). Need tight copy, routing rules for inbound, and a benchmark pull for the hero.

Sofia Kim: Love it. Proposed hero headline: 'Secure, SLA-backed inference that fits your network.' Three microsections beneath: Data controls, Reliability, Deployment options. Keep each to 3 bullets.

Arjun Mehta: For inbound routing: add form fields: deployment_preference, compliance_level (low|medium|high), estimated_annual_spend. Rule: if compliance_level == high OR estimated_annual_spend >= 50000 => route to AE; if deployment_preference==Private => route to Solutions Eng + Security. Example snippet: `{"deployment_preference":"Hosted|Dedicated|Private","compliance_level":"low|medium|high","estimated_annual_spend":number}`

Clara Song: Benchmark narrative for hero: call out a verified Redwood lab test: "At sustained embedding throughput, Dedicated with KV caching and 8-bit quantization reduced unit cost ~30% vs our self-host baseline; p99 generation latency ~120ms (internal lab)." Add qualifier "internal lab results; mileage may vary."

Noah Reed: Webinar tie-in: 30 min technical webinar + live Q&A. Proposed date Dec 8. Slides: 1) customer problem, 2) architecture (routing, caching, KMS), 3) benchmarks, 4) deployment checklist, 5) CTA. Promo: blog + targeted email to trial users + in-product banner.

Sofia Kim: Legal/phrase check: use "supports customer-managed KMS, VPC/private control plane, and audit logs." For SLAs: "SLA-backed uptime subject to standard exclusions (scheduled maintenance, force majeure)." Avoid cert claims unless validated.

Arjun Mehta: AE playbook bullets: 30-60 day procurement for Dedicated + security review; required docs: DPA, network diagram, IP allowlist; contacts: Solutions Eng + Security reviewer.

Clara Song: Creative: I'll do two hero variants (icon + minimal). Also mini chart for cost per 1M tokens comparing Hosted / Dedicated / Self-host.

Noah Reed: Action list: @Arjun build lead-routing rules + JSON; @Sofia finalize compliance phrasing with legal; @Clara design hero + chart; I'll draft one-pager copy and CTA options for A/B test ("Request enterprise trial" vs "Schedule secure demo"). Meet Fri 9AM to finalize.
